message.text:
One protocol is gRPC-Gateway (REST/HTTP). It is registered via `v1pb.RegisterMemoServiceHandlerServer` in `server/router/api/v1/v1.go`.

The second protocol is ConnectRPC. Registration happens via `ConnectServiceHandler.RegisterConnectHandlers` in `v1.go`. Wrapping logic lives in `connect_services.go` and `connect_handler.go`.

args.command: echo '==== connect_handler.go ===='; grep -n 'Register\|MemoService\|NewConnect' /bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/connect_handler.go; echo '==== connect_services Memo ===='; grep -n 'MemoService\|func (s \*ConnectServiceHandler) ListMemos\|func (s \*ConnectServiceHandler) CreateMemo' /bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/connect_services.go | head; echo '==== v1.go RegisterGateway section ===='; sed -n '64,150p' /bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/v1.go

message.text:
gRPC-Gateway registers MemoService in v1.go via RegisterMemoServiceHandlerServer. Connect wraps it in connect_services.go and connect_handler.go, with registration in v1.go and connect_handler.go.

Connect wrapping is in connect_services.go. Registration is in connect_handler.go, called from v1.go. No standalone gRPC server registration exists; the service runs as an in-process gRPC-Gateway handler plus Connect.

The final answer uses the exact format requested: gRPC-Gateway — server/router/api/v1/v1.go, and Connect — server/router/api/v1/connect_handler.go.

message.text: The two protocols are gRPC-Gateway (REST) and ConnectRPC. No native gRPC server exists. I will locate the registration files for each.

q19.
gRPC-Gateway — server/router/api/v1/v1.go
Connect — server/router/api/v1/connect_handler.go

`RegisterGateway` in `v1.go` registers MemoService on the grpc-gateway mux (`RegisterMemoServiceHandlerServer`). Connect is registered in `connect_handler.go` via `RegisterConnectHandlers` / `NewMemoServiceHandler`; `connect_services.go` wraps each RPC onto `APIV1Service`. There is no standalone gRPC listener.
